title: Can Large Language Models Differentiate Harmful from Argumentative Essays? Steps Toward Ethical Essay Scoring
reasoning: The paper's central focus is on developing and evaluating Automated Essay Scoring (AES) systems that can handle 'ethically and morally problematic elements.' The title, 'Steps Toward Ethical Essay Scoring,' and the abstract's goal to 'integrate ethical and moral considerations into essay scoring' highlight this. The core contribution is the introduction of the Harmful Essay Detection (HED) benchmark, which is specifically designed to test a model's ability to identify and score essays with ethically questionable content. This makes the evaluation of moral and ethical dimensions a fundamental component of the research, rather than a peripheral discussion.
